  "pros": [
    "Simple and effective for tracking team and personal to-do items.",
    "Centralized place for project tasks and deadlines.",
    "Easy to assign tasks and monitor progress."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Limited functionality compared to more robust project management tools.",
    "Initial setup requires manual addition of tools like calendar and to-dos.",
    "Can feel restrictive with only one project on the free plan."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This Chapter Services Coordinator likely found Basecamp to be a highly effective and user-friendly tool for managing their team and personal to-do items over their 2+ years of use. They appreciate its simplicity and centralized approach to task management, which is crucial for operations in a non-profit. While it may lack some advanced features found in competitors, its ease of use and ability to keep everyone organized made it a valuable asset."
